paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism

model_annotation: This donut chart, titled "Task Type," visually represents the distribution of tasks performed by generative AI across journalism agencies, with the data aggregated over both agencies. The chart is composed of three distinct slices, each labeled with its corresponding task and percentage. The largest segment, colored a muted red, represents "Article generation" at 83.1%. The second largest segment, colored yellow, corresponds to "Headline generation" at 12.8%. The smallest segment, colored blue, indicates "Article editing" at 4.1%. Each category is labeled externally with its name and percentage, and the chart features a white central circle containing the title "Task Type." The slices are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top left and moving clockwise.
